sources.title: Phonon 31M - open source | LLM Reference
sources.snippet: Phonon 31M is Gradium's smallest open on-device text-to-speech model, released October 20, 2026 under Apache 2.0. It has 31 million parameters (excluding the audio tokenizer), speaks English as streaming 24 kHz mono audio, and runs on laptop CPUs, phones, browsers and GPUs; Gradium says it starts speaking in about 7 ms on a laptop CPU. sources.title: Gradium's Phonon Runs Text-to-Speech in Browsers at Under 75 MB ...
sources.snippet: The flagship phonon-31m-en model uses 31 million parameters and ships under Apache 2.0. The broader family supports English, French, German, Spanish, and Portuguese, although its larger models carry non-commercial licenses. Phonon generates compact audio representations with a flow-matching transformer, producing one 80 ms frame at a time.
